title: Settings
styleHint: Glass gives translucent, blurred surfaces. Classic keeps solid surfaces. Independent of light/dark.
calendarHint: First and last day of the month and week follow this calendar — not the language.
currencyHint: Rial is shown ×10 (10 rial = 1 toman). Dollar is a label only.
backupHint: Keeps money, calendar, notes, and these settings on this device. App updates keep your data. Uninstalling does not.
updateCheckFailed: Could not check. Connect to the internet and try again.
privacyBody: Everything stays on this phone. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
remindersHint: Default for money items. You can override per item when editing. Calendar reminders still use their own on-time / day-before switches.
calendarItemsHint: Choose which items appear on the month grid and agenda. Colors: gold events, rose birthdays, coral debts, teal receivables.
